mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM song) AS songCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM song WHERE audit_status = 3) AS activeSongCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer) AS singerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer WHERE cert_status = 2) AS certifiedSingerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist) AS playlistCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist WHERE type = 0) AS officialPlaylistCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE DATE(last_login_at) = CURDATE()) AS dailyActiveUser, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(play_count), 0) FROM song) AS totalPlays, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(play_count), 0) * 3.5 / 60 FROM song) AS totalListenHours, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_favorite WHERE target_type = 1) AS playlistSaves, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_favorite WHERE target_type = 0) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_favorite WHERE target_type = 2) AS shareCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE DATE(registered_at) = CURDATE()) AS newUserToday, 12 AS songTrend, 5 AS singerTrend, 8 AS playlistTrend, 18 AS userTrend

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.play_count DESC) AS `rank`, s.title, si.name AS singerName, s.style, s.play_count AS playCount FROM song s LEFT JOIN singer si ON s.singer_id = si.id WHERE s.audit_status = 3 ORDER BY s.play_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT style AS label, COUNT(*) AS value, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM song), 0) AS percent, CASE style WHEN '流行' THEN '#EC4899' WHEN '摇滚' THEN '#F97316' WHEN '电子' THEN '#8B5CF6' WHEN '民谣' THEN '#10B981' WHEN '嘻哈' THEN '#F59E0B' WHEN 'R&B' THEN '#06B6D4' WHEN '古典' THEN '#6366F1' WHEN '爵士' THEN '#D946EF' ELSE '#589286' END AS color FROM song GROUP BY style ORDER BY value DESC
